title: RuneEra [RPG Colony Sim], similar to RimWorld in a fantasy world with RPG progression
author: Targma
selftext:
Hey everyone, I'm the solo developer of RuneEra. I've been working on it for over 4 years. It's a fantasy colony sim, similar to RimWorld with Valheim-like progression and party-based RPG combat.

During the last year I used AI to help meet the art demand, especially effects icons. I use existing sprites as style references and check the results for consistency and readability in-game. I also hired   
an artist for the cover art to make it consistent with the game's theme.  


\[Try the free demo on Steam\](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5062040/RuneEra\_Demo/)  
  
The demo covers the first tier of content out of five, and you will be able to continue your save on release.

I'd love feedback from people who enjoy colony sims or RPGs. Does the tutorial explain enough without overwhelming you? How does building your settlement and controlling your adventuring party feel?

I also put together a short trailer. After watching it, do you feel like you have a good idea of what you do in RuneEra? Is there anything you wish it showed more of?

comments.author: ViolinistTemporary
comments.body: It looks like rimworld but worse

replies.author: Targma
replies.body: Fair point, the gameplay and combat is RPG focused and there is tiered progress.
